title: 看看, 试试: doing something a little
summary: Lets you make an action sound short and relaxed by saying the verb twice, as in 我看看.
explanation:
Saying a verb twice makes the action sound brief, casual or polite: 我看看 'Let me have a look', 你试试 'Give it a try.' You can also put 一 in the middle: 看一看.

Two-syllable verbs repeat as a whole: 休息休息 'take a little rest', 介绍介绍 'introduce briefly'. Don't use the doubled verb for something that is happening right now or for a long time.

examples.en: Try on this piece of clothing.
Tell us a bit about it.
Think about it for a moment.

mistakes.why: Two-syllable verbs repeat as a whole: AB AB.
Don't double a verb for an action in progress.

why: This repeats 了 and isn't a request.

exercises.prompt: Which means 'Let's take a little rest'?
why: Repeat the whole verb, not one syllable.

exercises.instruction: Make it sound casual: 'give it a try'.
why: 了 twice doesn't make it casual.

exercises.en: Have a look at this book.
exercises.why: The doubled verb 看看 works like a normal verb: it comes before the object.

why: Right choice: this one is wrong — a doubled verb doesn't go with 正在.
This one is fine: 'let me look at your book'.
This one is fine: 'have a listen to this song'.
Don't double the syllables one by one.
了 makes it a finished action, not a friendly request.
